accuracyChecks.method: 5 random generated items per chapter (105 items) plus one full mock (30 items) re-solved by hand against NCERT Fundamentals of Human Geography, India: People and Economy and Practical Work in Geography Part II; numeric items (frequency, standard deviation, rank correlation, choropleth classes, growth rate) recomputed
fixes: match categories whose right-hand items repeated (push/pull, factor types) removed so no Match-List has two equal answers
correlation match set no longer mixes a diagram name with coefficient values
two Give-a-reason answers reworded to stand as full sentences (sex ratio, urban noise)
NCERT sub-field list used for social geography; Kolkhoz item no longer names a leader not given in NCERT
